# TokenRevokeScope

`schemas/api/scope/token-revoke.json`

The scope of token.revoke (docs/design/m0/04 "Token administration", 14 M4): the live token to revoke. Its bearer is rejected from then on and the streams opened with it close. Its holder stays live with its grants, even with no token left: an operator's is recovered offline (14 R7). Only an operator revokes in this build.
